The Haluaghat Police after investigation submitted charge sheet No. 97 on 19-12-1996 as a strong prima facie case was made out against the accused persons under sections 143/323/324/326 and 302/34 of the Penal Code. Subsequently the accused persons were put on trial before the Additional Sessions Judge, Second Court, Mymensingh. During the course of trial the learned Additional Sessions Judge framed the charge under sections 324 and 326 of the Penal Code against accused Rustum Ali and under sections 143 and 302/34 of the Penal Code against accused Osman Ali, Rustum Ali, Ninda Begum, Alimuddin and Faizuddin and the charge was read over and explained to the accused persons who pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
